text.en: Su Shi passed the jinshi examination in 1057

claims.excerpt: 嘉祐二年（1057年），苏轼才20岁，与弟弟苏辙一同进京参加会考，之后两人皆中进士。

text.en: Su Shi passed the jinshi examination in 1057
Su Shi went to Hangzhou as vice-prefect in 1071
text.zh-CN: 苏轼于1071年赴杭州任通判

claims.excerpt: 滞留京城至熙宁四年夏末，神宗批示“改通判杭州”，遂经由陈州赴杭，十一月到任。

text.en: Su Shi lived in Hangzhou from 1071
Su Shi lived in Mizhou from 1074
Su Shi was ordered to Mizhou

claims.excerpt: 至熙宁七年夏回到杭州。过了几个月接到诏命前往密州，九月二十日告别杭州道友，十月启程。

text.en: Su Shi lived in Xuzhou from 1077
Su Shi arrived in Xuzhou and joined the flood relief when the Yellow River broke its banks
text.zh-CN: 苏轼到徐州，黄河决口时参加救灾

claims.excerpt: 四月二十一日，到徐州。是年七月七日，黄河决口，水困徐州，苏轼参加救灾。

text.en: Su Shi became prefect of Huzhou in 1079

claims.excerpt: 元丰二年（1079年）三月，移知湖州。四月二十九日，到湖州任。

text.en: Su Shi lived in Huzhou in 1079
Su Shi was jailed in 1079 over the Crow Terrace poetry case and nearly died
text.zh-CN: 苏轼于1079年因乌台诗案入狱，几乎丧命

claims.excerpt: 八月十八日，下狱。十一月三十日结案。此次苏轼因乌台诗案入狱，几死

text.en: Su Shi served as deputy military training commissioner of Huangzhou from 1080
text.zh-CN: 苏轼自1080年任黄州团练副使

text.en: Su Shi escaped death and was demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Huangzhou
text.zh-CN: 苏轼免于一死，被贬为黄州团练副使

claims.excerpt: 苏轼终免一死，贬谪为“检校尚书、水部员外郎、黄州团练副使，本州安置，不得签书公事”

text.en: Su Shi lived in Huangzhou from 1080 to 1084
In Huangzhou Su Shi roamed the hills and rivers among fishermen and woodcutters
text.zh-CN: 苏轼在黄州放浪山水，与渔樵杂处

claims.excerpt: 苏轼在黄州“深自闭塞，扁舟革履，放浪山水之间，与渔樵杂处”

text.en: Su Shi used the art name Dongpo Jushi
In Huangzhou Su Shi farmed a plot he named Dongpo and called himself Dongpo Jushi
text.zh-CN: 苏轼在黄州躬耕一块地，命名为东坡，自号东坡居士

claims.excerpt: 朋友马正卿为苏轼请到了黄州营地以东一块地，苏轼躬耕其中，命名为“东坡”，复于元丰五年营造雪堂，自号东坡居士。

text.en: Su Shi had the courtesy name Zizhan

label.en: First Ode on the Red Cliff

text.en: Su Shi wrote the First Ode on the Red Cliff in 1082 after visiting the Red Cliff near Huangzhou
text.zh-CN: 苏轼于1082年游黄州赤壁，写下《前赤壁赋》

claims.excerpt: 元丰五年（1082年），苏轼先后两次游览了黄州附近的赤壁，《前赤壁赋》写于首次游览黄州赤壁时。

text.en: In 1084 Su Shi was moved from Huangzhou to Ruzhou
text.zh-CN: 1084年苏轼由黄州改任汝州团练副使，离开黄州

claims.excerpt: 元丰七年（1084年）苏轼由黄州团练副使迁汝州团练副使，四月六日离开黄州

text.en: Su Shi lived in Ruzhou from 1084
In 1093 Su Shi was impeached and sent out as prefect of Dingzhou

claims.excerpt: 元祐八年，言官黄庆基、董敦逸弹劾苏轼。八九月间，苏轼出知定州。

text.en: Su Shi lived in Dingzhou from 1093
Su Shi was exiled to Huizhou in 1094

claims.excerpt: 绍圣元年（1094年），章惇、安焘执政，苏轼遭来之邵弹劾，遂被哲宗贬谪至惠州

text.en: Su Shi was placed under supervision in Huizhou
Su Shi lived in Changhua Military Prefecture from 1097 to 1100
text.zh-CN: 苏轼1097年至1100年居于昌化军

text.en: In 1097 Su Shi was demoted and placed under supervision in Changhua
text.zh-CN: 1097年苏轼被责授琼州别驾，昌化军安置

claims.excerpt: 绍圣四年（1097年）二月十四日，营建白鹤峰新居。五月责授琼州别驾、昌化军安置。

text.en: Su Shi was exiled further, to Danzhou on Hainan Island
text.zh-CN: 苏轼又被贬至儋州（海南岛）

claims.excerpt: 绍圣年间因新党的章惇为相，又加贬谪至儋州（海南岛）

text.en: In 1100 Su Shi's place of exile was moved to Lianzhou, and soon he was allowed to live in Yongzhou
text.zh-CN: 1100年苏轼的贬所移至廉州，随即又改为永州居住

claims.excerpt: 元符三年（1100年），徙贬所于廉州，随即又任舒州节度副使、永州居住。

text.en: Su Shi lived in Lianzhou from 1100
Su Shi died in Changzhou
Su Shi had a younger brother, Su Zhe

claims.excerpt: 苏轼有一个弟弟苏辙，小他两岁（1039年出生），两兄弟从小到大一起读书游玩，后来也同一年中进士。

text.en: Su Shi was born on 8 January 1037 (Julian)
text.zh-CN: 苏轼生于1037年1月8日（儒略历）

text.en: Su Shi died on 24 August 1101 (Julian)
text.zh-CN: 苏轼卒于1101年8月24日（儒略历）

text.en: Su Shi was born in Meishan
Su Shi died in Changzhou
Su Shi was buried at Jia County
Su Shi's courtesy name was 子瞻
Su Shi's courtesy name was 和仲
Su Shi's art name was 东坡居士
Su Shi's art name was 铁冠道人
Su Shi's art name was 東坡居士
Su Shi's father was Su Xun
Su Shi's mother was Cheng（Wife of Su xun）
Su Shi's spouse was Wang Fu
Su Shi's spouse was Wang Zhaoyun
Su Shi's spouse was Wang Runzhi
Su Shi's child was Su Guo
Su Shi's child was Su Dai
Su Shi's child was Su Mai
Su Shi's sibling was Su Zhe
text.zh-CN: 苏轼的兄弟姐妹有苏辙

text.en: Su Shi was born in 1036 (Chinese lunar year)
Su Shi died in 1101 (Chinese lunar year)
Su Shi died at the age of 66 (East Asian age reckoning)
Su Shi was born in Meishan
